mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, nickname, phone, avatar, balance, status, create_time, update_time FROM `user` WHERE username = #{username} LIMIT 1
SELECT id, username, password, nickname, phone, avatar, balance, status, create_time, update_time FROM `user` WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `user` (username, password, nickname, phone, avatar, balance, status) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{nickname}, #{phone}, #{avatar}, #{balance}, #{status})
mapper.select:

AND (username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE `user` SET balance = balance + #{amount} WHERE id = #{id}
